title: Aggregated fills as a typed JSON array
source:
import json, os
import pandas as pd
f = pd.read_csv("/input/environment/data/fills.csv", dtype={"trade_id": str})
def side_of(v):
    s = str(v).strip().upper()
    return "BUY" if s in ("BUY", "B", "1", "+1", "1.0") else "SELL" if s in ("SELL", "S", "-1", "-1.0") else s
out = []
for tid, g in f.groupby("trade_id", sort=True):
    qty = float(g["fill_qty"].sum())
    out.append({"trade_id": str(tid), "side": side_of(g["side"].iloc[0]), "qty": int(round(qty)),
                "px": round(float((g["fill_qty"] * g["fill_px"]).sum() / qty), 4)})
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
json.dump(out, open("/app/output/trades.json", "w"), indent=2)
